The audit is read-only. I will check the candidate texts and the existing K modules against the reuse, S0, and Sprint 0 claims before voting.**Vote: the current K scope is not adequate.** Sprint 0 cannot exit, and Sprint 1 must not start. This seat does not close W-D0–W-D6 or M4-C1–M4-C5.

**Identity.** This seat is Grok 4.7, from the session preamble. No separate runtime receipt was supplied for this review. The earlier surge reconciliation records completed Grok seats as `grok-4.7-build` (`deliverables/mil4-k-surge-2026-09-29/AUDIT-RECONCILIATION.md:11`). The four candidate digests in the assignment were not recomputed here. The worktree texts match the packet. No K, Quint, or test command was run.

**Packet.** It is sufficient for this inadequacy vote. It is not sufficient to approve any old file as reuse-unchanged, to freeze S0 bytes, or to treat the surge as an S0 proof.

## Reuse and admission

The reuse text withholds old proofs and withholds family admission.

- Historical `moriarty.k`, fixtures, locks, and SP03 receipts are archive evidence. Adaptation waits on a documented Source/6→Core/5 mapping. Family arithmetic is a sketch. `prove` stays `PROOF_UNIMPLEMENTED`, and no old theorem carries (`experiments/moriarty-language/formal/mil4/semantics-contract.md:46-48`).
- That matches the runner (`experiments/moriarty-language/formal/k/run.py:113`), the K header (`experiments/moriarty-language/formal/k/moriarty.k:1`), and the K readme (`experiments/moriarty-language/formal/k/README.md:147`).
- `m4dAdmit` rejects every non-later family with `FAMILY_STAGE_ADAPTER_ABSENT`, including `loan-s0/1` (`deliverables/mil4-k-surge-2026-09-29/sol-defi.k:74-78`, `sol-defi.k:96`). The reconciliation records the same boundary (`AUDIT-RECONCILIATION.md:22`).
- `coverage.tsv` has `proof_status=open` throughout, no `reuse` row, and no admitted profile. Profile rows are `FAMILY_STAGE_ADAPTER_ABSENT` / `adapt-projection` / `proposed`.

`adapt-projection` and `map-or-reject` are still open labels. The plan’s four dispositions are reuse-with-equivalence, adapt-and-re-review, archive, or replace (`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-29-mil4-k-quint-completion.md:19`). No `formal/k` file has one of those rows. The old transfer constructor is one amount (`moriarty.k:10`), so it is a different signature from literal-fee `v+f`.

## Missing obligations, especially S0

The six names exist only as English, in an unfrozen order (`semantics-contract.md:30`). Coverage gives `MIL4:Stage`, `MIL4:CompleteEffect`, `MIL4:AtomicRejection`, and the other MIL/4 rows `k_rule_or_reject=missing`, `fixture=none`, `proof_status=open`. There is no `S0:` row.

The only implemented six-judgment chain is escrow `M4T/1` (`deliverables/mil4-k-surge-2026-09-29/sol-contract.k:100-229`). Its intent judgment passes when the external `m4cNativeQualified` premise is present (`sol-contract.k:122-126`). That is not an S0 signature, digest, or verifier.

S0 exact effects are prose: debit `v+f`, credit `v`, credit `f`; debit/credit `n`; accrued `min(n,a)`; principal remainder; one allowance and one replay; head advance (`semantics-contract.md:36-38`). The surge repay rule is a schema match, and its prepared summary keeps only the debt delta (`sol-family-effects.k:92-113`). No literal-fee transfer rule is in that K. Missing from the register as separate leaves: fee-recipient line, alias resolution, allowance, replay, work, predecessor/head, obligation status, `feeCap`, `grossDebitCap`, and the `2^127−1` obligation cap.

These S0 rejections are unnamed in `coverage.tsv`: unknown tag, version mismatch, omitted creditor or fee line, recipient substitution, stale head, replay, `f=feeCap+1`, overdraft, credit overflow, `n>outstanding`, `p=2^127−1` with `a=1`, nonempty observation/duty/disclosure sets, and any division, rounding, reserve, mint, foreign evidence, or accepted fee-bearing failure.

The proof register required by the plan is absent (`2026-09-29-mil4-k-quint-completion.md:15-16`). A Source/6→Core/5 signature opens, and leaves open: determinism, progress-or-defined-rejection, type preservation, finite termination, residual-duty conservation, exact effects, authority/history non-reuse, and source/Core/evaluator correspondence. Quint `α` is defined only for an admitted stage, and no omitted-field record exists (`experiments/moriarty-language/formal/mil4/projection.md:3`, `projection.md:20`).

## Minimum next slice

Finish the register before any new K rule. Add S0 effect-line and named-rejection rows, one archive/adapt/replace row per current `formal/k` file with no reuse-unchanged row, and the open proof names above.

The first code slice after a voted register is one new `formal/k/mil4/` S0 module: literal-fee transfer and funded AccrualFirst repay through all six judgments, checked UInt128, obligation cap `2^127−1`, and the hostile cases above. Keep every first profile on `FAMILY_STAGE_ADAPTER_ABSENT`. Keep `prove` at `PROOF_UNIMPLEMENTED`. Leave the surge escrow and `m4eCheck` schemas outside that module.

## Sprint 0 exit flaws

1. The candidate’s own exit is unmet: every production needs a rule or named rejection, every S0 leaf needs an exact disposition, and two votes must agree (`semantics-contract.md:52`). Source/5 and Core/4 rows are `unmapped` / `map-or-reject` / `inventory`. All twelve decision rows are open (`decisions.md:5-18`). The inventory seats are not frozen-byte votes (`decisions.md:20`).
2. File disposition is deferred to “before Sprint 1” (`semantics-contract.md:48`), while the plan requires that classification at Sprint 0 exit (`2026-09-29-mil4-k-quint-completion.md:42`).
3. S0 bytes remain proposed `/3` while the language candidate is Source/6→Core/5 (`semantics-contract.md:7-9`). There is no single K state signature.
4. W-D3 still requires a valid signed failure (`decisions.md:10`), while S0 has no accepted fee-bearing failure (`semantics-contract.md:36`). W-D4 still asks for AMM-fee and vault-remainder evidence (`decisions.md:11`), while S0 excludes division, rounding, and reserves (`semantics-contract.md:36`).
5. The plan’s Sprint 0 Quint artifact, `common.qnt`, is absent. `projection.md:1` is a design map and records that no model has run.
6. Surge compilation and `m4AdmitFamily` do not satisfy the exit. A family projection is not coverage (`2026-09-29-mil4-k-quint-completion.md:13`). SP01.6 stays blocked.
